title: apt-get update fails: a decommissioned internal mirror entry never got cleaned up
description_md:
This host has no real internet access -- it only ever installs from an internal package mirror baked into the image. Lately, `sudo apt-get update` fails outright, which is also breaking any script here that chains `apt-get update && apt-get install ...`. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), read what apt is actually complaining about, and fix the source list so updates -- and installs from the still-healthy internal mirror -- work again.

You're done when `apt-get update` succeeds cleanly and packages from the internal mirror (e.g. `reportviewer`) are resolvable again.
